tool_calls.arguments:
{"content":"apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: my-app-deployment
  labels:
    app: my-app
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: my-app
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: my-app
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: my-app-container
        image: nginx:latest
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: "50m"
            memory: "128Mi"
          limits:
            cpu: "200m"
            memory: "256Mi"
","path":"app-deployment.yaml"}
